sheet_listed_ipos: INDIA IPO TRACKER QUICK STATS
Currently Open IPOs
Upcoming IPOs
Closed (awaiting listing)
Listed (all-time archive)
SETUP INSTRUCTIONS - one time, about 5 minutes
In this spreadsheet, click: Extensions > Apps Script
Delete any code shown, and paste the ENTIRE script from the file 'IPO_Tracker_AppsScript.gs' (shared in the chat)
Click the Save (floppy disk) icon
In the toolbar dropdown, select the function 'updateAll' and click Run
Google will ask for authorization: Review permissions > choose your account > Advanced > Go to project > Allow
If the first run filled the tabs with data, it works. If there is an error, note the message and ask in chat
For automation: in the left sidebar of the Apps Script editor, click the clock icon (Triggers)
Add Trigger > function: updateAll > event source: Time-driven > type: Day timer > 8am to 9am > Save
DONE - the sheet now updates itself every morning automatically. No AI, no cost, no server.
NOTES
Data sources: Chittorgarh / NSE India. GMP is unofficial grey-market data and can be manipulated - verify with the RHP before investing.
If a website changes its layout, the script may need a fix - come back to the chat and ask for an updated version.
